description: This file defines the DashboardResponse class, which is a data transfer object (DTO) used to encapsulate dashboard data such as sales, order count, and recent orders in the billing software.

classes.name: DashboardResponse
classes.description: A DTO class representing dashboard metrics including total sales for today, count of today's orders, and a list of recent order responses.

methods.name: getTodaySales
methods.description: Getter for todaySales, returns the total sales amount for today.

methods.name: getTodayOrderCount
methods.description: Getter for todayOrderCount, returns the number of orders today.

methods.name: getRecentOrders
methods.description: Getter for recentOrders, returns a list of recent order responses.
